mapper.select: SELECT version FROM knowledge_docs WHERE id=#{docId,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND metadata->>'deleted_at' IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,user_id,state,phase,progress,attempt,error_code,result,rebuild_of,created_at,updated_at FROM app_ingestion_jobs WHERE id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND (user_id=#{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT} OR #{admin,jdbcType=BOOLEAN})
mapper.update: UPDATE app_ingestion_jobs SET state='queued',phase='queued',progress=0,error_code=NULL,result=NULL,updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND state='failed' AND attempt<3
UPDATE app_ingestion_jobs SET state='cancelled',updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND state IN ('queued','processing')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM app_ingestion_jobs WHERE state='queued' ORDER BY created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE app_ingestion_jobs SET phase=#{phase,jdbcType=VARCHAR},progress=#{progress,jdbcType=INTEGER},updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND state='processing'
mapper.select: SELECT state FROM app_ingestion_jobs WHERE id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE app_ingestion_jobs SET state='failed',error_code=#{errorCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR},updated_at=now() WHERE id=#{id,jdbcType=OTHER} AND state='processing'
UPDATE app_ingestion_jobs SET state='failed',error_code='WORKER_INTERRUPTED',updated_at=now() WHERE state='processing' AND lease_until<now()
